purpose: Second-pass story-image backlog selected from output/story-visual-gap-report-v01.json.

rules.execution: Generate, inspect and integrate exactly one asset at a time.
rules.identity: Prefer clean mother sheets. If no clean identity mother exists, frame the scene around objects, hands, silhouettes or environment rather than inventing a new face.
rules.uiSafeArea: Keep the lower 22 percent quiet for dialogue UI.

jobs.promptSeed: Close view of a child's careful fingers depressing old piano keys only halfway while the hammers remain short of the strings; Noi watches as a soft silhouette outside the focal plane; rain, sealed piano, no sounding note.

The abandoned station broadcast wakes by itself while a gloved hand holds one broken half of a white pendant under the clock; the matching silhouette appears only as a distorted reflection in wet black glass, no readable text and no visible villain face.

Two cold hands align a frost-sealed resonance recorder, tuning one human voice out of blue-white noise; the mother's profile remains an incomplete reflection in the instrument glass, never a resurrected body.

A restrained private-room still life: a handwritten voluntary contract oath, a numbered plate engraved with a personal name and one white-gold gloved hand resting beside them; identity through objects, no readable paragraph text.
The black opera train begins to collapse; mechanical applause hands stop mid-clap, velvet curtains tear loose and the first honest breaths fog the carriage windows, with no victory lineup.

Sequence Four seriously compares one sweeter and one slightly charred roasted chestnut under circus string lights, a tiny ordinary decision treated with the same care as a tactical choice; preserve her exact recovered face and white feather-like outfit.
Steam, two tea cups and relaxed hands at a hot-spring edge; nobody is hurried into speaking, wind bells and terraced fields soften in the background, healing through unforced silence.

An elderly witness with a cane reaches the hearing podium and publicly acknowledges the old wounds of the Zero Conductor plan; frame from behind and across the silent audience so no unverified close face is invented.
Sequence Four tells Anning she wants to become someone who can catch others, not only someone rescued; both sit by a modest campfire, eye contact hesitant and equal, no romance pose.

A torn investigation-note corner, an unopened invitation seal and the protagonist's pendant are placed together on a dark archive table as the clue about the mother's refusal lands; no readable prose and no new face.

An unsent handwritten letter draft is lifted from a half-open secret compartment beside a familiar old hairpin and dust-covered acoustic diagrams; emotion through hands and objects, no readable paragraph text.

Two hunter sisters reset a snowfield warning line together in mirrored practical motions while a traveler watches, allowing the memory of another separated pair of sisters to carry warmth instead of only pain; faces remain secondary.
